messages:
maria: quick standup — what I did: finished the AZ mapping for us-west2 + validated node labels for GPU pools. blocked: waiting on quota increase request in GCP for A100s (INFRA-3421). today: will follow up with cloud-ops and start provisioning the canary 8x-a100 pool.

josh: +1 on the mapping, saw it in the repo. what quota number are we asking for?

maria: requested +24 A100 GPUs (to cover canary + 2 DCs for staging), submitted via the console and ticket INFRA-3421. pasted CLI just in case:

```
gcloud compute regions quotas update us-west2 --project=redwood-infra --metric=GPUS_A100 --limit=48
```

sara: what about h100 headroom in eu-central? we still only have the default 8 there.

leo: I talked to accounts yesterday — we can repurpose some unused reserved capacity from a paused workload in eu-central, should free up ~12 H100s. I'll open a transfer request.

maria: awesome, that helps.

josh: blockers: waiting on the org-level approval for cross-project quota increases; PV team needs the final sign-off. today: will chase approval and start the terraform module for the a100 node pool.

sara: what I did: tested autoscaler with mixed-spot/ondemand in ap-southeast-1, it behaved weirdly when spot reclaim rate >40% (pods stuck Terminating). blocker: need a post-drain hook to force pod eviction after 2m. today: I'll prototype a preemptible-aware daemonset.

maria: noted — file an issue with repro steps and I can help tune the cluster-autoscaler flags.

leo: FYI — quota increase timeline from GCP support is usually 24-72h. if we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow we'll escalate to the TAM.

devops-bot: Deploy pipeline update: infra/provisioning/a100-canary started (run #88). status: queued -> awaiting quota confirmation.

josh: quick question — for Dedicated customers, do we want to route canary traffic to the new pool or keep it only internal?

maria: internal only for now, we'll enable a small percentage once we're at steady-state (metrics for 2h). add a flag in the rollout config: `canary.public=false`.

sara: on quotas — reminder: AWS spot GPU limits are separate per AZ, watch out for us-west-2a vs us-west-2b. we had a failed run last week because 2a was exhausted.

leo: I'll add an automated pre-check that queries GPU availability per AZ and fails the plan if available < requested. will submit PR today.

maria: last note: cost estimate for canary 8x-a100 + burst buffer looks ~ $18k/mo if on-demand, drop to ~$6k/mo with 70% spot. include those numbers in the PR description. :money_with_wings:

josh: thanks — ping me when the terraform PR is up, I'll review.

sara: filing INFRA-3430 for the post-drain hook work. linking here for context.

maria: thanks team — I'll update INFRA-3421 with any responses and close the loop in this thread later today. :white_check_mark:
